label: Chambered Argonaut
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square transparent Glaze artwork. PELLICLE SHOAL, fictional sea organisms sculpted entirely from WET BACTERIAL-CELLULOSE PELLICLES. Our own reference sea-dragon supplies only the physical material and soft lighting; create a different subject. Very thin cloudy translucent amber/tea/ivory bio-fibre membranes, densely visible fine cellulose fibrils, irregular torn fibrous edges, doubled opaque fold lips and a few water beads at seams. Diffuse light through cloudy fibre with loose folded laminae and genuine gaps, convincing macro craft photograph. No smooth solid core, glass, glossy resin, gelatin candy, plastic, ordinary animal skin, woven fabric, wood shavings, paper quilling, metal or thread. Entire subject inside central70% with generous true transparent margins; every projecting arm, fin or tail whole. No environment, exterior glow, external bubbles, floor, cast shadow, backing panel, frame, typography, UI or clock/battery/calendar symbols. One readable singular silhouette at85px, no sheet/collage. SUBJECT: one complete CHAMBERED ARGONAUT, a living small octopus curled within one broad thin ribbed bowl-like nautiloid shell. The shell is entirely cloudy ivory cellulose pellicle, gently translucent, with a single elegant open coil silhouette and strong radiating crumpled fold ribs, open lip facing left. A small amber soft head and two tiny dark eyes peek from that lip; a handful of delicate slender curling arms and TWO broader membranous paddle-arms extend gently around the rim. The thin shell is a visibly fibrous wet sheet folded into a shell, not smooth calcite or glass, not concentric paper-quilling rolls. Keep the open shell lip and individual arms clear. No sea-dragon or broad elephant ears.
processing: Entire original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square. Alpha preserved, no subject crop/recolour/artistic edits.
